name: Compliance specialist
summary: Turns long rules, contracts and privacy duties into plain summaries, checklists and calendars. Keeps board records in order and lists the questions to take to a lawyer.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 official sources (GDPR and UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, EU AI Act, UK company filings), four skills, five prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs. No legal rulings; attesting and certifying stay with auditors.
